text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Four minutes, twenty-five seconds until commencing today's mission—"assist Flower in constructing a new special for the cafeteria."

text_block_list.name: Dormmates
text_block_list.text: It's Miho Dorm vs Ritto Dorm! Time to find out whose menu will become the cafeteria's next special!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Today, the dorms are battlin' to see who can create the best set menu! The winner's set will be featured as a limited special at the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: While the dorm leaders and masters will be the judges, competitors will also appraise the opposing team's submission.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Representing Miho Dormitory is Rice Shower and her sous-chef, Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not sure if I can do this, but I'll do my best! Let's do this, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You don't have a thing to worry about with me—the class representative—here by your side!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And representing Ritto Dormitory is Nishino Flower and her sous-chef, Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Commencing mission to produce a new cafeteria special.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… So, what do you think we should start with? Oh, the main course is supposed to be a meat dish, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, sauteed pork. A sample has been provided for us, so let us test it now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Garlic and pepper detected. I suspect this is a type of barbecue sauce, but its spiciness level is above average.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Among today's taste testers is Rice Shower, who dislikes spicy foods. I suggest that we create a different sauce.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: How about we make a sweet sauce, then? Go ahead and choose one that you like!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Searching for "sweet sauces." Results found—teriyaki sauce, Madeira sauce, chocolate sauce…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Chocolate would make it a dessert! Oh! How about orange sauce?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is a classic in French cuisine. I agree with your proposal.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I got inspired by the outfit you're wearing! Hehe, see, you have a little orange slice in your hair.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. Speaking of which, you were the one who suggested this design for me when I was deciding what to wear.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did! And I'm so glad you went with it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Wearing this outfit reminds me of the dessert contest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because that too required teamwork in the kitchen. When I cook in this outfit, it makes me think about how others will receive our food.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It compels me to try tweaking and improving a recipe, rather than simply following it exactly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is why I thought it appropriate to wear this for today's competition.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow, you put so much thought into this… Hehe. Let's get to work on making something really tasty!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. In fact, I already have another idea.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What do you think of including a choice of side dishes for individuals like Bakushin O, who place great importance on nutritionally balanced meals?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's a great idea! Okay, for side dishes, we can do a salad, a stewed dish, some pickled goodies…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Aaand stop! Time for some taste testin'! Let's start with what Miho Dorm made!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um… So… We decided to go with a nutritionally balanced main dish and chocolate cake as an extra treat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This sweet treat is our way of applauding everyone for their daily efforts!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Also, Bourbon's outfit looks like a chocolate cake so, um, I thought it might be one of her favorite foods…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So… yeah! That's why we chose to add a slice of chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You considered what I might like and included it as a special treat?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They must have been thinking of us while putting together their meal too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The results are in! The judges say… Miho and Ritto Dorm are tied winners! Both set menus will be sent to the cafeteria's chef!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Since both teams paid such careful attention to their opponents' preferences, we found both sets worthy of being served at the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-we did it! Ehehe! Isn't that great news, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am looking forward to eating today's meal again in the future.
